_doc: Thermal lane results. See docs/gripper/analysis/thermal.md. Tags in 'inputs' and 'limits'.

input_file_sha256_16.note: sha256 (first 16 hex) of every input file

hold_torque_Nm_at_5N.note: 2 F r_c / eta, r_c 65 mm, eta 0.85 (DESIGN-BASIS 2)

eta_gearbox.note: dyno.json; motor current = T / (K_out eta_g), motoring side, conservative

k_PETG.note: Tychanicz-Kwiecien, Grosicki, Markowicz, 'Experimental Investigation of Thermal Conductivity of Selected 3D-Printed Materials', Materials 18 (2025) 3950, doi 10.3390/ma18173950: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12428860/ (retrieved 2026-10-11)

k_PA6CF.note: no public value found; range 0.25-0.8 W/m/K

case_R26_C.note: DESIGN-BASIS R26: servo case <= 60 C after 30 min of the duty cycle

case_servo_rating_C.note: DS3218 operating temperature upper limit 70 C (servo_temp); applied to the case, which is conservative because the rating is an ambient

winding_C.note: dyno.md winding limit 125 C (enamel and brush life)

petg_Tg_C.note: Bambu PETG Basic DSC glass transition (petg_tds)

petg_HDT_1p8_C.note: Bambu PETG Basic HDT ISO 75 at 1.8 MPa (petg_tds)

petg_HDT_0p45_C.note: Bambu PETG Basic HDT ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa (petg_tds)

petg_creep_onset_C.note: judgement: Romeijn 2021 (petg_creep) saw stress-dependent (non-linear) flexural creep at 50 C under 17.6 MPa [D from an assumed 48 mm span]; the mount screw clamp stress is 14-28 MPa (section 3 of thermal.md), so 50 C is taken as the temperature above which the clamped PETG creeps measurably

sources.petg_tds: Bambu Lab PETG Basic Technical Data Sheet V2.0 (copy hosted by Additive-X): https://www.additive-x.com/shop/mpattachments/file/viewonline/id/580/product_id/2330 (retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.petg_k: Tychanicz-Kwiecien, Grosicki, Markowicz, 'Experimental Investigation of Thermal Conductivity of Selected 3D-Printed Materials', Materials 18 (2025) 3950, doi 10.3390/ma18173950: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12428860/ (retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.petg_creep: Romeijn, Singh, Behrens, Paul, 'Effect of accelerated weathering on the creep behaviour of additively manufactured PETG', J. Polymer Research 28 (2021) 352, doi 10.1007/s10965-021-02707-7; accepted manuscript https://opus.lib.uts.edu.au/handle/10453/151771 (retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.air: Engineering ToolBox, Dry Air - Thermodynamic and Physical Properties (300 K and 350 K rows): https://engineeringtoolbox.com/dry-air-properties-d_973.html (retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.churchill_chu: Churchill & Chu, Int. J. Heat Mass Transfer 18 (1975) 1323-1329, doi 10.1016/0017-9310(75)90243-4; form as given in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nusselt_number (retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.horizontal: Horizontal-plate correlations 0.54 Ra^1/4 (hot face up) and 0.27 Ra^1/4 (hot face down), L = A/P, after Incropera & DeWitt (2007), as given in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nusselt_number (retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.emissivity: Engineering ToolBox, Emissivity Coefficients (anodized aluminium 0.77, black anodize 0.88): https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/emissivity-coefficients-d_447.html; black plastics 0.85-0.92: https://www.design1st.com/Design-Resource-Library/engineering_data/ThermalEmissivityValues.pdf (both retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.servo_temp: ServoDatabase, Miuzei DS3218: operating temperature -15 to 70 C, aluminium case: https://servodatabase.com/servo/miuzei/ds3218 (retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.tpu_tds: Ultimaker TPU 95A TDS (HDT 50.3 C at 0.45 MPa): https://um-support-files.ultimaker.com/materials/2.85mm/tds/TPU-95A/Ultimaker-TPU95A-TDS-v5.00.pdf (cited in DESIGN-BASIS 4)
sources.asa_tds: Bambu ASA Technical Data Sheet V3.0 (HDT 100 C at 0.45 MPa, 92 C at 1.8 MPa, Vicat 106 C), copy: https://polyalkemi.no/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Bambu_ASA_Technical_Data_Sheet.pdf (retrieved 2026-10-11)
sources.maxon: maxon 'DC motor and EC motor Key information' (two-resistance winding/housing structure): https://people.ece.ubc.ca/leos/pdf/datasheets/Maxon/MaxonSpecs.pdf (via dyno.md)
sources.ds3218: DS3218MG data via docs/gripper/research/actuators.csv A17 (idle 5 mA, Miuzei datasheet)

step1_note: Hold = lift + feed (25 s of 35 s). Close = 0.5 s at 0.5 x stall current [A]. Electronics inside the servo: idle 5 mA x 6.5 V [S] + H-bridge I^2 x 0.1 ohm [A]. ESP32, INA219 and buck are off the gripper [A]; a gripper-mounted buck would add (1 - eff) x rail power.

step4_material_option.note: ASA raises the housing limits by about 30 K (HDT at 0.45 MPa 100 vs 69 C) [S asa_tds]; it changes no temperature and no servo limit

step4b_note: Back-off 0.4225 = eta_g^2 is the BEST case: the command sits exactly at the gearbox friction threshold, zero margin. Any real back-off stays above it. 'pwm' = discontinuous-conduction bound.
